data.name: February
data.gender_notes: February is used as a neutral name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of February is recorded in name-lists as “Month of purification”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: February expresses “Month of purification”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of February total 42, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: אבר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The month named after the Roman god of purification and the Roman month of February, derived from the Latin word 'februare', meaning 'to purify'. In Hebrew, it could be interpreted as 'month of the river'.

in_greek.name: Φεβρουάριος
in_greek.long_meaning: The month named after the Roman god of purification, in Greek it translates to 'purifier'.

in_latin.name: Februarius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Roman god of purification, from which the month of February derives its name.
